我简单讲讲这个逼养的和特斯拉中国的所谓恩怨：
1、他的公司，曾经借过一台Model S，然后特斯拉中国按照内部规定锁了急加速功能（大致如此），这个逼试车，然后就不爽了，认为是瞧不起它，然后就把自己和特斯拉中国人员的沟通聊天记录发到网上了，这是他不人揍的之一；
2、FSD有望在国内推出前夕，它在竞品工程师的指使下，特意跑到美国，特意去所谓测试Cybertruck，彼时，和3/Y相比，Cybertruck的FSD成熟度明显更低一些，但这逼养的专门挑所谓软肋来，这是他不人揍的之二；
3、有意它太过嚣张跋扈，最终得罪了竞品车商，给他全网封杀了，复出之后，有些善良的特斯拉车主以为它知错就改了，结果，这个逼养的继续之前那套阴阳手法，于是就借着所谓小红书上一个小傻逼账号的所谓“人去楼空”来黑特斯拉。这个逼养的“鸡贼”的地方在于，它不直接说，而是故作吃惊地说，“FSD凉凉了，我买FSD的钱咋办”之类的，由于这个逼养的流量实在大，脑残粉丝实在多，所以这个就引爆了特斯拉中国在FSD方面“人去楼空”这种纯粹的谎言热点，这是他不人揍的之三。
打完收工。

onedoor japan official magazine 2026

jaehyun’s interview 💌

Q1. if you were to write a letter to yourself from debut time, what would you like to say?
🐶 “are you okay? aren’t you pushing yourself too hard?” that’s what i would like to ask. id like to say if you work hard the path will certainly open in front of you, so i hope you don’t lose your confidence. id like say to not let what ppl around you say sway you, and i hope you can strengthen you inner side a little bit more.

Q2. doing your activities until now, has there been a moment where you felt your heart wavering?
🐶 whether the public’s reaction is good or bad, i believe that as artists we should humbly accept it. and i am prepared to do so.
more than that, the moments where i can feel i’m inexperienced are still the most difficult for me. but i think that kind of frustration is also part of the growth process. even if my heart wavers, i think all i need is to pull myself together again and find the courage to move forward.

Q3. when expressing your feelings in daily life, what do you feel is the most “like you” way to do it so?
🐶 i like expressing my emotions through music. i recommend songs that match the biorhythm of the day to listen. and i  personally make playlists for close friends. since you can express various emotions through music, at sad moments or at fun times, i believe that the power music holds is really strong.

Q4. what feelings did you put into the fan song from your 1st studio album, HOME? 
🐶 it’s a song that contains a love confession towards onedoor. i honestly expressed even the trivial feelings i felt until i reached this far to stand here. or how much of a great comfort onedoor were whenever we were hesitant, we put each member’s individual story into the song. it’s a song that is good to listen to slowly and deeply.

Q5. i heard that you like to write. you also contributed in writing lyrics for your 1st studio album, HOME. where does your inspiration come from?
🐶 there are many cases where your inspiration switches on in a moment you could never imagine. for example, when i’m talking to my friend, or when i’m using my phone. or it suddenly comes to me when i’m taking a shower. i can’t exactly say where comes from, but i think reading books or writing regularly helps with that.

Q6. i heard that you like writing by hand too?
🐶 as much as digital (writing) is convenient and fast, there are times when the exact detailed emotions of that moment don’t stay in your memory. if you write down each thought that comes to mind carefully and syllable by syllable it stays in your memory for a longer time. and since i get new inspiration as i write things down, i always keep a notebook and pen in the studio.

Q7. what’s the reason why you never slack off your effort and manage yourself thoroughly. 
🐶 i’m the type of person who wants to do sth perfectly once i’m doing it. more than believing that onedoor are gonna love me no matter what, i think it’s better when there are enough reasons and value for ppl to like the artist that i am. whatever it is, i try to make the final result as high quality as possible.

Q8. what kind of artist do you want to grow into in the future?
🐶 we want to make our music a more compelling music. whatever new challenge we take on, i want us to be a group where you can nod in agreement with and say “if it’s boynextdoor then that’s possible.” 
one of my personal goals for this year is to show onedoor much more of “myung jaehyun as a person” rather than “singer jaehyun.” not only musically, but also as a person, i want to be an artist who is not ashamed to face onedoor.

items.translation_zh:
onedoor japan official magazine 2026

jaehyun 的采访 💌

Q1. 如果要给出道时期的自己写一封信，你想说什么？
🐶 “你还好吗？是不是把自己逼得太紧了？”我想这样问。我想说，只要努力，道路一定会在你面前打开，所以希望你不要失去自信。我想说，不要被周围人的话左右，希望你能把内心再锻炼得更强大一点。

Q2. 活动至今，有没有过感到内心动摇的瞬间？
🐶 不管大众的反应是好是坏，我相信作为艺人，我们都应该谦虚地接受。而且我也做好了这么做的准备。
比起这些，能感受到自己还不成熟的瞬间，对我来说仍然是最困难的。但我觉得那种挫败感也是成长过程的一部分。即使内心动摇，我想我所需要做的也只是重新振作起来，找到继续前进的勇气。

Q3. 在日常生活中表达自己的感受时，你觉得最“像你”的方式是什么？
🐶 我喜欢通过音乐来表达情绪。我会推荐适合当天生物节律的歌曲来听。也会亲自为亲近的朋友制作播放列表。因为可以通过音乐表达各种各样的情绪，所以无论是在悲伤的时刻还是开心的时候，我都相信音乐所拥有的力量真的很强大。

Q4. 你在第1张正规专辑中的粉丝曲《HOME》里放入了怎样的心情？
🐶 这是一首包含了对 onedoor 的爱情告白的歌曲。我坦率地表达了直到走到这里、站在这里为止所感受到的那些细小心情。还有每当我们犹豫不决时，onedoor 给了我们多么巨大的安慰，我们把每位成员各自的故事都放进了这首歌里。这是一首适合慢慢地、深深地聆听的歌。

Q5. 听说你喜欢写作。你也参与了第1张正规专辑《HOME》的作词。你的灵感来自哪里？
🐶 很多时候，灵感会在你完全想不到的瞬间被打开。比如我和朋友聊天的时候，或者我用手机的时候。也会在我洗澡时突然出现。我没办法确切地说它来自哪里，但我觉得读书或规律地写作对此有帮助。

Q6. 听说你也喜欢手写？
🐶 虽然数字化（写作）很方便也很快，但有时候那个瞬间细致准确的情绪不会留在记忆里。如果把脑海中浮现的每一个想法都仔细地、一字一句地写下来，它会在记忆中停留更久。而且因为我在写下东西的过程中会获得新的灵感，所以我总是在工作室里放着笔记本和笔。

Q7. 你从不懈怠努力、彻底管理自己的理由是什么？
🐶 我是那种一旦做某件事，就想把它做到完美的人。与其相信 onedoor 无论如何都会爱我，我觉得作为艺人的我，能让人们喜欢我的理由和价值足够充分会更好。不管是什么，我都会努力让最终结果尽可能高质量。

Q8. 你未来想成长为什么样的艺人？
🐶 我们想让我们的音乐变得更有吸引力。无论我们接受什么新的挑战，我都希望我们能成为一个让大家点头认同并说出“如果是 boynextdoor 的话，那是可能的”的组合。
我今年的个人目标之一，是向 onedoor 展现更多“作为一个人的 myung jaehyun”，而不是“歌手 jaehyun”。不仅在音乐上，作为一个人，我也想成为一名能够坦然面对 onedoor、不感到羞愧的艺人。

🎞️ | 260728 | Jacky Deng, driver and automotive engineer, xiaohongshu update.

🏁Number 85 single-handedly propelled Chinese GT racing into the mainstream.

Motorsport is an extremely expensive sport. Track maintenance, team operations, and event execution cannot be sustained by passion alone. Many veteran motorsport bloggers agree that Wang Yibo has truly raised public awareness of Chinese motorsport and local automotive culture, bringing tangible positive value to the industry. His down-to-earth and tenacious attitude, his fierce fighting spirit on the track, and his clean and crisp racing lines demonstrate his genuine dedication to professional racing, not just a dabbling stunt. It is a rare stroke of luck for Chinese motorsport to have such a positive and powerful public figure in the niche motorsport industry.

The recently concluded 2026 China GT Zhuhai round perfectly showcased the results of his accumulated training. During the event, continuous torrential rain caused severe flooding and extremely low visibility on the Zhuhai track, leaving very little room for error. Many veteran drivers made mistakes. Wang Yibo, representing the UNO Racing team in the highest GT3 category, started from 18th place overall, adopted a dry-tire strategy, and steadily improved his position by using precise braking and meticulous racing lines to overtake other cars cleanly. Sensing the intensifying rain, he immediately switched to a steady pace, maintaining a flawless performance with zero scrapes and mistakes throughout the first 30-plus minutes of the race, safely handing the car over to his teammate. In the four days of practice before the race, he broke his personal fastest lap time at the Zhuhai circuit four times, ultimately finishing with a time of 1 minute 37.133 seconds, a 0.75-second improvement over his track debut in 2024, demonstrating visibly continuous technical progress. After the official review of the results, the car in front was penalized for a violation, and car number 85 was successfully promoted to runner-up in the GT3 AM+ class, every point a testament to his long-term accumulated strength. In the post-race interview, he didn't discuss the results, only sincerely wishing all drivers a safe finish; his gentle yet professional racing spirit was particularly touching.

The value he brings goes far beyond the podium:

✅ Breaking down barriers: Tickets for the Zhuhai station sold out quickly, attracting a large number of young and female spectators with no prior experience in racing, injecting new vitality into the niche world of motorsports.

✅ Empowering industry development: Driving well-known brands to support China GT continuously, commercial resources are used to upgrade the track and train young athletes, alleviating the pain points of domestic races in terms of sponsorship and operation.
✅ Reshaping public perception: Through systematic training, strict adherence to rules, and consistent performance in harsh rain conditions, he breaks the prejudice that "celebrity racing is just a gimmick," conveying the pure spirit of competitive sports.
Respecting the rules, refining his skills, and giving his all, Wang Yibo uses his influence to make Chinese motorsports culture, hidden in a niche circle, visible to a wider audience. Rooted in his passion and deeply involved in the local racing scene, he quietly contributes to the development of Chinese motorsports beyond its niche. Such persistence and responsibility deserve everyone's recognition. ✨

🎞️ | 260728 | 车手兼汽车工程师 Jacky Deng，xiaohongshu 更新。

🏁85号单枪匹马地将中国 GT 赛车推向了主流。

赛车运动是一项极其昂贵的运动。赛道维护、车队运营和赛事执行，无法仅凭热情维持。许多资深赛车博主都认同，Wang Yibo 确实提升了公众对中国赛车运动和本土汽车文化的认知，为这个行业带来了切实的正向价值。他脚踏实地且坚韧的态度、在赛道上强烈的拼搏精神，以及干净利落的行车线，都展现出他对职业赛车真正的投入，而不只是浅尝辄止的噱头。在赛车运动这个小众行业中，能拥有这样一位正面且有力量的公众人物，对中国赛车运动来说是难得的幸运。

刚刚结束的 2026 China GT 珠海站，完美展现了他长期训练积累的成果。比赛期间，持续暴雨导致珠海赛道严重积水，能见度极低，留给失误的空间非常小。许多资深车手都出现了失误。Wang Yibo 代表 UNO Racing 车队参加最高级别 GT3 组别，从全场第 18 位发车，采用干胎策略，并通过精准刹车和细致的行车线稳步提升名次，干净地超越其他赛车。察觉雨势增强后，他立即切换为稳健节奏，在比赛前 30 多分钟全程保持零擦碰、零失误的完美表现，安全地将赛车交给队友。赛前 4 天练习中，他 4 次刷新自己在珠海赛道的个人最快圈速，最终以 1 分 37.133 秒完赛，相比 2024 年首次在该赛道亮相提升了 0.75 秒，展现出肉眼可见的持续技术进步。经官方成绩复核后，前车因违规被罚，85号车成功递补为 GT3 AM+ 组亚军，每一分都见证了他长期积累的实力。赛后采访中，他没有谈论成绩，只是真诚祝愿所有车手都能安全完赛；他温柔而专业的赛车精神格外令人动容。

他带来的价值远不止领奖台：

✅ 打破壁垒：珠海站门票迅速售罄，吸引了大量此前没有赛车观赛经验的年轻观众和女性观众，为小众的赛车运动世界注入了新的活力。

✅ 赋能行业发展：推动知名品牌持续支持 China GT，将商业资源用于赛道升级和年轻运动员培养，缓解国内赛事在赞助和运营方面的痛点。
✅ 重塑公众认知：通过系统训练、严格遵守规则，以及在恶劣雨战条件下稳定发挥，他打破了“明星赛车只是噱头”的偏见，传递出竞技体育的纯粹精神。
尊重规则、精进技术、全力以赴，王一博用自己的影响力，让隐藏在小众圈层中的中国赛车文化被更广泛的受众看见。源于热爱，深度参与本土赛车现场，他默默为中国赛车运动的破圈发展作出贡献。这样的坚持与责任，值得每个人认可。✨
